title: The curvature estimation of the complete Kähler-Einstein metrics on the disk bundles
summary: In this paper, we study some geometric properties of the disk bundles over the complete Kähler manifolds. When the base space is the complete Kähler-Einstein manifold, we compute the holomorphic sectional curvature, Riemannian sectional curvature of the complete Kähler-Einstein metric on the disk bundle. Moreover, we present a parametric criteria for whether the manifold admits negative pinched property.
